title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 18
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút (Listening ~45 phút audio chạy liên tục, Reading 75 phút). Chủ đề: sửa đồ vest, chấm công, cửa hàng đồ trượt tuyết, modem Internet, kỷ niệm ngày cưới, thư viện đại học, bảo tàng thiếu hướng dẫn viên, tạm ngưng thẻ gym, vườn nho, tái chế thuỷ tinh, ứng dụng ngân hàng, soi chiếu an ninh sân bay, lớp nấu ăn, dắt chó đi dạo, tiêm phòng cúm, cốc tái sử dụng, quán ăn 75 năm, thuê thiết bị chụp ảnh, họp dân về quy hoạch, chính sách công tác, lễ hội mùa hè, phiếu giảm giá bảo dưỡng xe; đủ dạng hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn. Mỗi câu có giải thích tiếng Việt.

groups.transcript: Let's talk about the customer survey results for our mobile banking app. Overall, customers rated the app four out of five stars. Brightline Corp. – Travel Policy (excerpt)

• Employees must book flights through the company's travel portal at least 14 days before departure.
• Economy class is required for flights under six hours. Business class may be booked for flights of six hours or longer with a manager's approval.
• Hotel costs may not exceed $200 per night, except in the cities listed in Appendix B, where the limit is $300.
• Meal expenses are reimbursed up to $60 per day.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Travel Request Form
Employee: James Porter
Destination: London (listed in Appendix B)
Dates: June 3–7
Flight: New York–London, 7 hours, business class requested
Hotel: The Kensington Grand, $280 per night
Purpose: Meetings with European distributors
Submitted: May 15

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: James Porter
From: Rachel Adams
Date: May 16
Subject: Your travel request

Hi James,

As your manager, I've approved your request for business class on the flight to London. Your hotel is also within the limit for that city, so please go ahead and book it.

Please remember, though, that meal expenses above the daily limit won't be reimbursed, even in an expensive city like London. Also, please book your flight through the portal by Friday.

Rachel

questions.explanation: 'Business class may be booked for flights of six hours or longer with a manager's approval.'

options.D: It is within the allowed amount.

questions.explanation: London thuộc Phụ lục B (giới hạn $300); khách sạn $280/đêm → trong mức cho phép.

Riverside Summer Festival – Vendor Information

The Riverside Summer Festival will take place on July 19 and 20 in Riverside Park. We welcome food vendors, artists, and local businesses.

Booth fees:
Food vendor • $250 (both days)
Arts and crafts • $120 (both days)
Nonprofit organization • Free

All booths are 3 m × 3 m and include one table and two chairs. Electricity is available for an additional $40. Applications must be received by June 15. Vendors will be notified of their booth locations by July 1.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Vendor Application
Business name: Sweet Street Treats
Contact: Olivia Grant
Type: Food vendor
Products: Homemade ice cream and frozen fruit bars
Electricity needed: Yes
Application date: June 10

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: Olivia Grant
From: Riverside Festival Committee
Date: June 30
Subject: Your booth

Dear Ms. Grant,

Thank you for applying to be a vendor at this year's festival. We are happy to confirm your participation. Your booth will be number 14, located near the main stage, where large crowds are expected.

Please note that vendors must set up their booths between 7:00 and 9:00 A.M. on July 19. Vehicles will not be allowed in the park after 9:00 A.M.

We look forward to seeing you there.

Riverside Festival Committee
